cultural.vision_reason: This is a traditional embroidered sheepskin waistcoat ("melles bunda") with characteristic dense floral embroidery, a garment type well documented for the Csángó/Hungarian folk-dress tradition of Romania/Moldavia.

physical.title: waistcoat
physical.summary: A man's sheepskin waistcoat, a 'melles bunda'.  Dark brown coloured fleece on the inside (back) and cream-coloured fleece on the inside (front).  Three main embroidered bands along the bottom of the cream-coloured leather waistcoat, with floral and circular motifs, worked in red, blue, green, brown, lilac and black wools, separated by raised braid-like embroidery.  The upper back has a large pattern comprising flowers and leaves.  Two small front pockets, with 'j.c.' embroidered on one and '1954' on the other.  Secured at the left (as worn) side with three leather toggles and loops and a further three at the left shoulder.  A band of black wool at the bottom (outside).
